name: processtask_history_confighash
label: Work Order Workflow History Data
description: The historical data of the workflow process diagram can be used for time dimension statistical queries and association queries related to the process.

fields.name: processtask_id
fields.description: Work order ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: config_hash
fields.description: MD5 hash of workflow configuration, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the processtask_id, config_hash fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.
